documentationRepack.explanation: The actual isolated Desktop used the first package. The final tarball updates only the two root README files (host badge and release/companion links). Every other packaged file has the same SHA-256. The final tarball passed its complete package audit; this is not a claim that the final archive itself was GUI-installed.

validationTriage: Updated reviewed minified updater names, graph pan fixture dependencies and OPS mode row IDs; retained exact drift rejection and native routing defaults.
Retained the kernel refLedgerAligned changes and local indexed-clone adaptations through the three-way rebase.
Added pinned public Cognition fixtures, isolated synthetic Git baseline and the upstream-recommended 600-second lint timeout; upstream assertions were not weakened.
Replaced Windows nested npm batch chains with direct sequential Node entry points for complete checks and audit-before-pack delivery.
Earlier parallel checks exhausted Windows commit memory; retained failed logs, serialized final validation and used an explicit Node heap budget. No failed attempt is counted as a pass.

Waited for the delayed synthetic welcome window and used its explicit skip-account action. The R41 UI harness clicks the left side of long targets so hover-expanded row actions cannot intercept saved-session selection.
Published upstream byte changes include line ending changes in frozen vendored trees; exact source bytes and hashes are retained.

The native-input harness now waits for a persisted child generation and checks summary/model-call counters; the previous dialog result could satisfy the old UI-only wait early. The failed attempt is retained.

A disposable-host interruption (exit 3758096392) during the native-input retry is retained. The final package was installed into the synthetic profile by the original host, and the native-input check passed in a fresh synthetic host lifecycle. The other 20 Desktop cases apply through the proved identical runtime payload.

Initial CI passed the main graph and Cognition but rejected the independent Forge dependency audit. The companion now also pins Undici 8.12.2, with rc.3 SDK versions unchanged. Clean installation/audit, 109 tests and the actual Host/Desktop/delivery checks were repeated.
limitations: Host support remains official Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3. Published 0.2.2-alpha.2 was reviewed as a candidate and not adopted; no mixed-generation SDK upgrade was made.

No external model generation, paid provider, real SSH endpoint, or external memory server was exercised. Local deterministic adapters cover native streaming, child lifecycle, compression and actual Forge execution; generated-summary quality and remote quotas/network behavior remain unassessed.

Cognition test_conformance, test_mr_m1 and test_mr_m2 each skip one optional unavailable private historical corpus check. Their synthetic assertions run; these three optional checks are not counted as passed.
The public Cognition fixtures validate source and build contracts; no Rust engine or upstream installer is registered or executed by the product.
Karpathy DSH Git, Archify npm 404 and the archive without a supplied remote remain explicitly unavailable. GitHub compare file lists may truncate; the kernel rebase used full Git objects.
Only synthetic profiles and independent test Desktop processes were used. No running user Desktop, user agent, profile or conversation database was modified.
Forge is delivered as a separate optional original companion. Historical rc.2 benchmark/stress results are labeled historical and do not certify rc.3 performance.
